critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 2008 lines — split by domain (auth, files, team, clients, services, notes, settings, ai) before it hits 3k.
In-memory rate limiter (_RATE dict) is per-process; behind multi-worker (uvicorn --workers>1) or restart the brute-force protection is trivially bypassed. Move to Redis / DB counter with TTL.

google_session_exchange: user_doc.get('active', True) check on line 298 uses `if not ... : raise ... else: update ...` structure — the else branch updates fields on the just-inserted new admin doc, but for pre-existing INACTIVE users the else never runs (good) yet the `user_doc.update` for the invited-but-not-yet-google-linked case is inside the else. Verify inactive existing user path returns 403 (it does — tested).
download_file: `request._headers = None` line 415 is a no-op guard on a private attr; remove — it does nothing and is misleading.
AI quota rate_limit(f'ai:{user_id}', 30, 86400) uses in-memory deque; a backend restart resets quota. Persist counters per user per day in Mongo for real enforcement.

TeamUpdate PATCH allows changing name/role/active but there is no email/username change path and no re-invitation email is sent. UX may confuse admins since new users can't log in until they use Google (google_linked false, no password). Consider explicit 'send magic-link' or password reset for invited users.
seed_admin only updates password_hash — if admin's role has been changed to viewer in Mongo it will NOT be restored. Consider re-affirming role:'admin' too.
settings redaction: only bank_card and bank_clabe are hidden for non-finance roles. Verify bank_holder/bank_bank (if any PII) don't leak — currently they are still shown to viewer (tested).
test_credentials: admin/armenta123 and viewer/viewer123 (viewer left active with role=viewer after tests)
